notes:
{湯葉|ゆば} is the delicate skin that forms on the surface of heated soy milk, lifted off and eaten fresh or dried (⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ hot water + {葉|ば} leaf, describing its thin, leaf-like look).

TYPES: ⟦{生|なま}→生：03509_nama⟧{湯葉|ゆば} (fresh, soft) vs. ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧{湯葉|ゆば} (dried, for cooking).

REGIONAL: Most associated with ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧, often served at Buddhist temples as ⟦{精進料理|しょうじんりょうり}→精進料理：16101_shoujinryouri⟧; also produced in ⟦{日光|にっこう}→日光：03515_nikkou⟧.

- {湯葉|ゆば}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put yuba in a simmered dish
